description: This file declares the interface for the Curl_get_line function used in the curl library to read complete lines ending with a newline character from a buffer or input stream. It contains include guards, licensing information, and includes dependencies via 'dynbuf.h'.

methods.name: Curl_get_line
methods.description: Declares a function that reads a complete line ending with a newline from the given input and stores it in the provided buffer.
